candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity:
Maitland City Council's Pathways program is a fantastic way to kick-start your career and gain professional experience in local government!
Commencing in January 2027, for a period of two years, we have two exciting opportunities for Graduate Civil Engineers to join our organisation.
In this role, you will undertake a graduate program developed specifically for you, giving you exposure to a range of civil engineering functions for the investigation and delivery of civil and recreation infrastructure projects undertaken by Council. These duties are going to help you develop a solid foundation to your civil engineering career.
About you:
To be successful in this role you will possess:
- Degree level qualifications in Civil engineering in the previous two years or completion of degree by January 2027
- Contemporary industry knowledge of civil engineering areas
- Experience and understanding in project support and the research, analysis and presentation of information
- Current Class C driver's licence
Benefits:
This Graduate position is temporary full time (two-year contract) with a commencing salary of $1,414.58 weekly, plus 12% superannuation. Graduates will also have access to Council's great staff benefits including:
- Flexible work arrangements
- One extra week of "My Leave" a year (to use how you like!)
- Ongoing training and development
- Fitness Passport
- Healthy Employee Program
To apply:
To apply for this opportunity, please click 'Apply Now' and submit your resume and cover letter.
Questions:
To viw the role charter click 'Apply Now'. If after reading the role charter you have any questions, please contact the recruitment team at Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au
More information regarding Council's Pathways Program can be viewed via https://www.maitland.nsw.gov.au/pathways-program.
Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2027
Only candidates with current Australian work rights (Australian citizens, permanent residents, NZ citizens with a current passport, valid work visa) will be considered.
What happens next?
Once applications close, we will review all candidates' details against the role requirements and will be back in touch with you to advise the status of your application.
Please note, prior to an offer of employment being made, recommended candidates will be required to undertake a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing). Council also completes a range of other pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, psychometric testing or a criminal history check. For more information about the recruitment process, visit the "Jobs at Council" page on our website.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Maitland City Council is dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive and supportive and is reflective of the diverse community we serve. We support equal opportunities for all employees, and encourage applications from people from all cultures, nationalities, identities, and abilities. We believe all employees have the right to feel valued, respected and heard. If you have any special considerations or accessibility requirements, please let us know in the recruitment process how we are able to meet your needs.
 If you require special assistance, or have any questions about the recruitment process please contact us for a confidential conversation (Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au)

candidates.content_text:
Why our People Choose Quickway
At the heart of our business are our greatest assets, our people, our culture and our core values of honesty, openness and fairness.
At Quickway, we are committed to nurturing talent and developing people. As we grow, we ensure that our people and their skills grow with us. Working with us, there are often opportunities to learn and build on your experience and we actively encourage professional development. We believe in building our people so that they can build Australia's future.
We partner with our clients and teams to deliver without compromising on our core values. We recognise and reward the efforts and achievements of our people.
Start Your Civil Engineering Career with Quickway
Quickway is a leading civil infrastructure contractor delivering projects across Roads & Bridges, Concrete Structures, Rail, Utilities, Communications, Electrical and Water Infrastructure throughout NSW and QLD.
We are seeking an enthusiastic Undergraduate Civil Engineer to join our team based at our Burleigh Waters Project in Queensland.
This opportunity is ideal for a 3rd or 4th year Civil Engineering student looking to gain practical, hands-on experience while completing their degree. Whether you are seeking your first engineering role, vocational placement or looking to gain exposure to live civil construction projects, we would love to hear from you.
No prior industry experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, willingness to learn and genuine interest in building a career in civil engineering.
About the Role
You will be part of the project team delivering the Cassowary Drive Bridge Replacement project, which has just kicked off, and will run through to completion in the second half of 2027. The project is a $18 million infrastructure project delivering a new flood-resilient bridge and improved transport connectivity for the growing southern Gold Coast community. Working alongside experienced Project Engineers, Site Supervisors and Project Managers, you will gain exposure to all aspects of project delivery including:
- Site-based engineering and construction activities
- Quality assurance and project documentation
- Construction methodologies and planning
- Safety and environmental compliance
- Subcontractor coordination
- Site inspections and reporting
- Quantity tracking and progress monitoring
- Survey and set out activities
- Contract administration and project controls
This is a hands-on role that will provide valuable exposure to the civil construction industry while allowing you to continue your university studies.
What You Will Bring
Essential
- Currently studying a Bachelor of Civil Engineering.
- In your 3rd or 4th year of study.
- Ability to travel to our Burleigh Waters project site.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
- Full working rights in Australia with the intention of pursuing a long-term career in Australia.
- A genuine interest in civil construction and infrastructure projects.
Desirable
- Current Driver's Licence.
- Previous construction, labouring or site-based experience.
- Completion of vocational placement or internship programs.
- White Card.
What We Offer
- Flexible work arrangements to support university commitments.
- Approximately 3 days per week with additional hours available during semester breaks and project requirements.
- Exposure to major civil infrastructure projects.
- Mentoring from experienced industry professionals.
- Practical experience that complements your university studies.
- Opportunity to transition into a Graduate Engineer role upon completion of your degree.
- Supportive team culture focused on learning and development.
 If you are looking to gain real-world engineering experience, work alongside experienced professionals and build a long-term career in civil construction, we would love to hear from you.   Apply now or contact Suzi Dimech at suzid@quickway.com.au for further information.

The Opportunity
Our client who is a first class civil engineering consultancy who is seeking a Graduate Civil Engineer to join their experienced Cairns-based engineering team.
This is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to projects that have a genuine impact, from roads that connect communities and drainage systems that protect property, through to bridges, culverts, water infrastructure and land development projects.
This consultancy provides civil engineering and project management services across government, private development, infrastructure and regional projects throughout Far North Queensland and beyond. Their project portfolio includes roads and drainage, water and wastewater infrastructure, subdivisions, bridge and crossing works, airports and major infrastructure projects.
The Role
You will be a hands-on member of the engineering team, contributing to the planning, design and delivery of a broad range of civil infrastructure projects.
This is more than producing drawings and technical reports. You will see projects progress from concept and design through to construction and completion, working alongside experienced engineers, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing practical and cost-effective civil infrastructure designs
- Supporting road, drainage, stormwater, water and land development projects
- Preparing technical drawings, documentation and engineering reports
- Assisting with project delivery and undertaking site inspections
- Monitoring construction outcomes, quality and project requirements
- Identifying technical issues and developing practical solutions
- Supporting approvals, compliance and stakeholder requirements
- Liaising professionally with clients, contractors and project stakeholders
- Working closely with senior engineers while developing your technical capability
About You
You will be a motivated Civil Engineer who enjoys civil design, practical problem solving and wants exposure to a diverse range of projects.
You will ideally have:
- Degree qualification in Civil Engineering
- Practical experience in civil design is a must
- Exposure to roads, drainage, stormwater, water, subdivisions or similar projects
- Strong technical and problem-solving skills
- Good attention to detail and an ability to manage competing priorities
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A practical approach to engineering and project delivery
- Current driver's licence and willingness to attend project sites
This role could suit an early-career Civil Engineer looking to build broader consulting experience, or an Engineer with several years of experience seeking greater project variety and responsibility.
Why Join This Engineering Consultancy?
They offer the opportunity to work alongside experienced Civil Engineers and project professionals on projects across both metropolitan and regional environments. The business places a strong emphasis on professional development, practical experience, integrity and delivering quality outcomes for its clients.
Job Offer
- $75,000 - $85,000 + super, negotiable based on experience
- Relocation assistance available
- Diverse civil projects from concept and design through to construction
- Exposure to roads, drainage, water, infrastructure and land development
- Hands-on project and site experience
- Mentoring from experienced senior engineers
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to contribute ideas and influence project outcomes
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career stability and genuine project variety
How To Apply
To build your career with a company that values quality engineering, practical solutions and the work you deliver, please click Apply and please include any civil design experience you have undertaken in your application.
About Us
With Head Office in Cairns and offices in Townsville and Brisbane. We specialise in professional, administration, engineering and industrial recruitment, permanent and temporary placements for both commercial and government enterprise. We are proud to connect great people with meaningful careers.

Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Beerburrum to Nambour (B2N) Rail Upgrade project.
This a major infrastructure project transforming the North Coast Line on the Sunshine Coast. The project includes rail duplication, new and upgraded transport infrastructure, improved road overpasses and enhanced signalling systems, all aimed at increasing capacity and reliability across the network. Once complete, B2N will deliver faster and more efficient travel while improving connections between the Sunshine Coast, Moreton Bay and Brisbane, creating lasting benefits for local communities and the region.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.

You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.

- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

Our Strategic Community Plan sets a clear direction: facilities that meet community needs, better public places, and infrastructure that is functional, inclusive and sustainable.
You’ll help turn those priorities into practical projects, balancing technical requirements, cost, risk and long-term asset performance. Across renewal, upgrade and growth projects, you’ll tackle varied challenges and see how your work contributes to the community.

candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting! 
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career? 
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry. 
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Structural Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland. 
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn. 
Why you’ll love working here 
Start building your career   Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical Structural drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters. 
Work on real projects   Go beyond the classroom and see how structural engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery. 
Learn from experienced people   Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow. 
Be part of a great team   Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do. 
Work in Fortitude Valley   Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity  
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to: 
- Assist with preparing structural drawings, plans and project documentation. 
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings. 
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes. 
- Develop your understanding of how structural engineering projects are designed and delivered. 
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements. 
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members. 
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop. 
About you: 
You could be a great fit if you are: 
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver, or currently studying Residential Drafting, or an equivalent qualification at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in structural drafting, design and engineering. 
- Curious and keen to learn new skills. 
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work. 
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback. 
- Reliable, organised and willing to have a go at new challenges. 
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team. 
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident. 
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career. 
What’s in it for you? 
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development. 
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave. 
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution. 
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs. 
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events. 
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program. 
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy. 
About STP Consultants  
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. 
We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take. 
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other. 
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes. 
Ready to get started?   
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you. 
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter. 
In your cover letter, tell us: 
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in structural drafting.   
2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants. 
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

CREATE YOUR FUTURE AT ATC WILLIAMS!
About Us:
Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with 45 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.
Why Join Us?
You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on an exciting period of growth, creating new opportunities for our people to work on diverse projects, take on greater responsibility, and continue developing their careers alongside experienced industry specialists.
About the Role:
We are looking for enthusiastic engineers who are curious, motivated and keen to continue developing their technical, project and client-facing skills while working alongside some of the industry's most experienced practitioners.
Our Perth team is currently seeking a Geotechnical/Civil Engineer on a permanent full-time basis.
Key Responsibilities and Activities Include:
As a Geotechnical/Civil Engineer, you will support the delivery of challenging mining, tailings, water and civil infrastructure projects across Australia and internationally.
Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will:
- Independently deliver technical investigations, analysis, design and reporting within own area of responsibility. 
- Prepare high-quality technical reports, calculations, specifications, drawings and project documentation requiring minimal review. 
- Review technical information critically and identify opportunities to improve project outcomes. 
- Continue developing your technical skills through hands-on project experience, collaboration and professional development. 
- Take ownership of defined project work packages from commencement through to completion. 
- Plan and coordinate personal work to achieve project milestones, budgets and quality expectations. 
- Assist Project Managers with project planning, scheduling and coordination activities. 
- Monitor progress against allocated tasks and proactively communicate emerging risks or issues. 
- Participate in site investigations, inspections and technical reviews where required. 
- Gain exposure to project management, client relationships and the broader aspects of consulting. 
- Support and mentor our undergraduates and graduates.
Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements Include:
You are an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to continue building your experience across project delivery and client engagement. You're motivated to learn, contribute to a collaborative team and take advantage of opportunities to grow your career.
To be successful, you'll bring:
- Tertiary qualifications in Civil/Geotechnical Engineering.
- Approximately 3+ years of consulting or industry experience in geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, tailings, mining infrastructure or land development projects. 
- Have a high standard of technical accuracy, professionalism and attention to detail.
- Ability to independently plan and undertake site investigations and field programs. 
- Strong technical report writing and data interpretation skills. 
- Experience managing fieldwork contractors, drilling programs and data collection activities. 
- Ability to manage work packages and coordinate project deliverables with limited supervision. 
- Experience working directly with clients and contributing to project delivery. 
- Familiarity with mining and tailings facilities, embankments, earthworks, seepage investigations, site investigations or land development projects. 
- Ability to mentor and support undergraduates and graduates. 
- Willingness to undertake regular site travel within Western Australia.
- Current Australian drivers licence.
What You Gain when you Join ATC Williams
As an entirely employee-owned organisation with a retention rate to be proud of, our talented and skilled people acknowledge two key reasons why they choose to stay at ATC Williams:
- The depth and generosity of our in-house knowledge and expertise, and
- The opportunity to work on a diverse range of technically challenging projects, learn from recognised industry experts, and build a career that can evolve into technical, project management and client leadership.
Employee Benefits include:
- Competitive remuneration package.
- Employee-owned company with the opportunity to purchase shares.
- Career and personal development opportunities & mentoring.
- Company paid parental leave.
- Flexible working arrangements available as required.
- Work on diverse mining, tailings, water and civil infrastructure projects across Australia and internationally.
- Learn from experienced mentors and nationally recognised specialists across our Australian offices.
- Opportunities to develop technical, project management and client-facing skills as your career grows.
At ATC Williams, we champion diversity, inclusion, integrity, and equal employment opportunities.
We encourage you to create your future at ATC Williams.
To apply, please provide a cover letter and CV as one attachment to your application and include:
- Rights to work in Australia (essential).
- Base Salary Package Expectation.
- Why you have applied for this role.
- What your career aspirations are.
Applications close Friday 23rd October 2026.

In this role, you will facilitate the delivery of road, drainage and ancillary works associated with subdivision developments, ensuring projects meet Council requirements and standards. - Ability to problem solve and think laterally to come up with innovative solutions to difficult problems.
